title: Pickleball Muck
style: fast tempo autralian rock, angry passionate ballard acustic guitar. male singer
lyrics:
legs heavy, 
feeeeet stuck. 
howm i gettin outta, this muck.

im gone.... bu mm bum bum mmm
 im broke ......bu mm bum bum mmm

abandon the
capsizing boat

body screaming, 
head in a cloud
shout it to rooftops
shout it out loud

im gonna plaaaaaaaaaay
im gonna,....plaaaaaaaaaay  aaaaaaay way

always playin at your best
'n' all you wanna do is rest

its my pickleball lust....
its not a maybe...
 its a must!

Sometimes its like...
"winner" take a bow, wave a hand
and sometime you wanna stick your head in the sand.

storey be told,
one thing is true

i have one love
and pickleball thats you!
